description: Every machine translation still waiting for a human, each with the source text and what the provider wrote, so a person can read both and decide. Read-only. Approving is deliberately not a tool here and never will be: a machine translation is unreviewed by definition, so accepting one is `verbaly review --approve`, run by a human. For how many drafts each locale has, verbaly_status is enough; verbaly_missing lists them next to the gate.
